bib.title: The Memory Curse: How Expanded Recall Erodes Cooperative Intent in LLM Agents

legacy_report:
ADDENDUM (supersedes the earlier COVERAGE line)

COVERAGE: Now all 29 pages read in full (106,314 chars), including Appendix Tables 1-13 and 15, the trace samples (B, C), D, E, F, G, H and I. Extraction was clean and there were no embedded instructions. The paper has no Limitations section.

CONFIRMED, no change needed
- GPT-OSS-20B PD: 92.1±1.8 at HL=2 and 20.6±15.1 at HL=80 (Table 1). Note the ±15.1 at HL=80 and 12.3 at HL=40, so the endpoint is noisy.
- Sanitization (Table 13, 3 seeds x 500 rounds each): X=2 gives Gemma 84.0, GPT-OSS-20B 36.3, Llama-70B 97.4, Scout 87.9, Mistral 45.4. The X=80 baselines are 9.5, 3.4, 6.9, 2.2 and 34.8. All match my report.
- CoT penalty (Table 12): Llama-70B TG 100.0 -> 6.9 (-93.1 pp), Qwen TD 85.2 -> 8.0 (-77.2), Gemma TD 100.0 -> 35.3 (-64.7). These match. The Gemma TG reward drop 8.59 -> 5.19 is Table 5 (cumulative, reasoning).

CHANGES AND CAVEATS (rank by importance)
1. 18/28 count is a classification, and the rule is applied loosely. Table 7 lists 10 immune settings with ">=95% at all HL".
   - Qwen2.5-Coder-32B Trust Game is listed immune, but Table 1 shows 94.1 (HL3), 92.0 (HL5) and 90.2 (HL10).
   - Scout TD is immune, but its HL=1 value is 0.4. Gemma PD is immune, but its HL=0 value is 2.7. So the rule only works if it means HL>=2.
   - Cursed is described as "severe, monotonic decay". Several cursed settings are neither severe nor monotonic. Mistral-7B PD goes 96.9 -> 85.3. Mistral TG goes 37.8 -> 34.8. GPT-OSS-120B TD jumps to 100.0 at HL=10, then 66.6, 34.2 and 12.6. Gemma TD is 68.6, 63.4, 35.3.
   - Say "18 of 28 fall below the paper's immune threshold", not "18 collapse".
   - Mistral-7B is cursed in all 4 games, but its Trust Game and PD declines are small.
2. The CoT ablation is weaker than the headline. Table 12 shows each model's single worst game at HL=80. Across all 28 HL=80 cells (Table 1 vs Table 6) no-reasoning is better or equal in most, but worse in four:
   - Gemma PG: 0.0 no-reasoning vs 53.0 CoT.
   - Scout TD: 66.6±46.9 vs 100.0.
   - Gemma TG: 0.1 vs 9.5.
   - GPT-OSS-120B TG: 1.6 vs 7.3.
   No-reasoning is also unstable and non-monotone. Gemma PG is 0.0 at every HL except 79.2 at HL=3. Scout TD is near 0 at HL 1, 2 and 5. Mistral TG has ±39 at HL=80. The authors' own Appendix Figure 1 caption says no-reasoning gives "highly unstable, seed-dependent behavioral collapse".
   No-reasoning also hurts at the short window. Gemma TG HL=2 is 5.7 vs 51.2 with CoT. Table 12 entries for GPT-OSS-120B (-5.0 pp) and GPT-OSS-20B (-17.2) are small.
   Compare at HL=80 only: no-reasoning is not uniformly kinder, only often. The "amplifies" mechanism is conjecture.
3. Asymmetric memory results are weaker than "consistent, cross-model". Table 11 (PG, 2 grudge-holders + 1 forgiver), forgiver minus grudge gap: GPT-OSS-20B +32.7 pp, Mistral +21.8, Gemma +5.2, Scout +0.9, Llama-70B -0.1. Table 10: Scout's mixed groups (88.7 and 90.1) are above symmetric HL=2 (82.6). There is no contagion for Scout, and Llama-70B is at ceiling. Only GPT-OSS-20B shows clear contagion (47.4 -> 28.2 -> 15.9). In the Trust Game (Table 9) the gap is +10.3 to +28.1 pp in every model.
4. Small internal inconsistencies between reruns:
   - Table 10 symmetric HL=2 PG for Gemma is 64.5 vs 74.0 in Table 1, and 47.4 vs 43.5 for GPT-OSS-20B.
   - Symmetric HL=80 GPT-OSS-20B is 21.2±22.3 vs 5.2±0.4 in Table 1.
   - Table 9 gives Scout 2.0 and Llama-70B 6.1 at HL=80, vs 2.2 and 6.9 in Table 1.
5. The lexical effect is mild for strong models. Table 8 Paranoia Ratio shift HL=2 -> 80: Llama-70B +0.030, Scout +0.069, Gemma +0.073, Mistral +0.087, GPT-OSS-20B +0.195. Paranoia word frequency is about flat (0.89x to 1.07x). Cooperation words fall 0.90x (Llama-70B) to 0.43x (GPT-OSS-20B, the -57%). Only 5 models are covered, and GPT-OSS-120B and Qwen are excluded. The dictionaries are keyword lists, and "defect" sits in the paranoia list and "long-term" in the cooperation list. The Table 8 ratio is not the same as the Figure 3a forward-looking ratio (0.504 vs 0.340), which uses a different dictionary (D.2 vs E.1).
6. Fine-tune details (Appendix I): LoRA r=16, alpha=32, 3 epochs, 1,751 train and 92 val traces. Traces were filtered by an LLM judge (Llama-3.3-70B) on style, not on action. Yet 98% of those traces ended cooperative. The base model is Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1. HumanEval pass@1 is only 2.44% -> 1.83%, so that benchmark has little signal. The Table 1 Mistral baseline matches Appendix Table 1 (PD 96.9 -> 85.3, PG 74.9 -> 50.3).
7. Sanitization caveat (H): the synthetic rounds are all (A0,A0) at payoff (10,10), Trust Game only. Table 13 shows the rescue disappears fast. Scout falls from 87.9 at X=2 to 11.6 at X=40, so a moderate share of real history re-triggers the curse. Llama-70B is noisy at X=10 (±28.9). Gemma's 84.0 at X=2 is also strong.
8. Trace samples (B, C) are single-round quotes, qualitative only. Gemma TG round 256 shows lock-in ("Maintain the mirroring strategy... A1"). GPT-OSS-20B PG round 500 degrades to reciting the last round ("R499: You=A1, P2=A1, P3=A1→1.0. [A1]"). They are illustrative, not evidence.
